title: Runescape: Dragonwilds - How to Get to the Scorned Wilderness (Reaching Commander Zilyana)
author: Jacob Fox
chapters: I attempt to lodestone into the Scorned Wilderness.
Location on the map to walk in from the Fractured Plains.
description:
Want to access the Scorned Wilderness in RuneScape: Dragonwilds? In this guide, I'll show you exactly where to go and what you need to do to enter the newest region in Dragonwilds.

0:23 - I attempt to lodestone into the Scorned Wilderness.
1:29 - Location on the map to walk in from the Fractured Plains.
3:19 - To see my walk in.

First, travel to the northernmost point of the Fractured Plains. From there, cross the river into the Scorned Wilderness using the bridge.

Follow the path through the Scorned Wilderness until you reach the Dragon Gate. As long as you've defeated all of the regional bosses, you'll be able to open the gate and continue through.

Once the Dragon Gate is open, you can walk straight through and make your way to Commander Ziltana.

The Scorned Wilderness is part of the game's full 1.0 launch and is the newest major region added to RuneScape: Dragonwilds.

Whether you're returning from Early Access or jumping into Dragonwilds for the first time, this guide will show you exactly how to get into the Scorned Wilderness.

Don't forget to subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds guides, gameplay, updates, and everything happening in Ashenfall!
